description: Current status of a public monitored target: overall state, uptime over 24h/7d/30d, last check time, last nightly scores, open incidents and the badge/status URLs. Use the owner (GitHub login) and target slug from the status page URL https://agentwares-agentcheck.vercel.app/<owner>/<slug>. No API key needed.

owner.description: GitHub login of the target's owner, e.g. demo
